name: Solanaceae: Another Time
source:
After bumping into a strange witch, Sal is told he was once the witch's lover in a past life. Though doubtful, Sal takes a leap of faith and gets his fortune read by the witch. What he learns sends him on a month long journey of self discovery and magical encounters...

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-another-time]itch.io[/url]]

Based on the comic [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-comic]Solanaceae[/url].
translation:
薩爾偶遇一名奇怪女巫，女巫告訴他，前世的自己曾是她的戀人。薩爾雖然懷疑，卻還是鼓起勇氣，讓女巫為自己占卜。占卜結果讓他踏上為期一個月的自我發現之旅，並經歷一連串魔法邂逅……

[來源：[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-another-time]itch.io[/url]]

改編自漫畫[url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-comic]《Solanaceae》[/url]。
